name: Haruna Soutarou
source:
A boy who's like an older sister, he's friendly to everyone. Despite seemingly making fun of everyone, he has more common sense than anyone else. He became a member after the former bassist, Shinya, withdrew. At that time, the name of the band was changed from S-leeper to Liar-S, and they started anew.

[Translation of [url=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/vita-liar/chara.html]official website character profile[/url].]
